title: Nutty Roasted Ethiopian Lamb Berbere Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Ethiopian stew made with lamb, plum sauce, and berbere spice, perfect for a winey and molten date-night dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the berbere spice to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the plum sauce, red wine, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
